# ProbMatrix

> ProbMatrix provides technology-driven risk management solutions, IFRS 9 automation, Expected Credit Loss (ECL) modelling support, risk modelling, model validation, stress testing, and risk management consulting for financial institutions and advisors.

## Core Solutions and Services

### IFRS 9 Excel Add-In
Excel-native IFRS 9 and credit risk management Add-In designed to automate Expected Credit Loss calculations and support audit-ready workflows.

Key capabilities and concepts:
- PD (Probability of Default)
- LGD (Loss Given Default)
- EAD (Exposure at Default)
- ECL (Expected Credit Loss)
- Macroeconomic scenarios
- IFRS 9 calculations and modelling
- Automated reporting and governance workflows
- Excel-based interface
- On-premise operation

### Risk Modeling Solutions
Ready-made risk modelling solutions intended to improve compliance and operational efficiency.

### Expected Credit Loss & Compliance
Expert guidance for ECL calculations and regulatory compliance for financial institutions.

### Risk Automation Services
Automation services focused on reducing manual input, improving accuracy, and streamlining financial risk management processes.

### Model Validation & Stress Testing
Model validation and stress testing services designed to assess reliability, compliance, and performance of risk models.

### Risk Management Consulting
Custom risk management and advisory services for financial institutions and risk teams.

## Target Industries

ProbMatrix serves:
- Commercial Banks
- Microfinance Institutions (MFIs)
- Development Finance Institutions (DFIs)
- Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs)
- Insurers
- Advisors and Consultants

## Key Product Differentiators

- Runs fully on-premise for day-to-day use; no internet connection is required for normal operation.
- Works inside Microsoft Excel through a user-friendly, form-based interface.
- Automates IFRS 9 workflows involving PD, LGD, EAD, ECL, and macroeconomic scenarios.
- Supports audit-ready workflows and faster reporting cycles.
- Designed by risk practitioners with practical IFRS 9 implementation experience.
- Helps teams review, challenge, and validate assumptions without rebuilding complex models from scratch.

## Company Positioning

ProbMatrix combines risk-modelling expertise with practical automation to help financial institutions move from manual, resource-intensive processes toward faster, structured, and audit-ready risk management workflows.

## Related Product

### CredX
CredX is referenced by ProbMatrix as a credit risk model validation and calibration tool for consultants, finance teams, validation teams, and risk professionals.
